text: At its First Meeting on December 2 and 3, 2014, City Council elected Councillor Shelley Carroll as Deputy Speaker. Councillor Carroll has resigned City Council effective April 5, 2018. In accordance with Section 27-42 of Chapter 27, Council Procedures, of the Toronto Municipal Code, City Council will elect a Deputy Speaker for the balance of the Council term ending on November 30, 2018.
City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018 elected Councillor Glenn De Baeremaeker as Deputy Speaker for the balance of the Council term ending on November 30, 2018.
